new_policies.name: student-double-bomb-shell-v1-normal
new_policies.description: Three fixed own-army swaps create two disjoint Bomb barriers around the Flag and free a trapped Lieutenant.
new_policies.model: Same guarded native move policy; Fortress-only setup with swaps a3/i2,b2/d1,c1/h1.
new_policies.information_model: Own-army constant placement only; zero opponent inputs, extra randomness or move-time work.

hypotheses: Requiring a surviving enemy Miner to clear two distinct unavoidable Bomb barriers can improve own Flag defence against an opponent that knows its location.
Separate the three-swap deployment package from fixing Fortress instead of the existing validated mixture.
analysis: Prespecified exploratory three-arm screen. Primary package comparison is double shell minus Fortress-only, with two secondary mixture comparisons. No parameter tuning. Same Flag/Spy/front row; three fixed swaps also free one previously trapped Lieutenant, so any effect cannot be attributed solely to Bomb-cut count. Miners capture-and-advance, so extra Bombs do not guarantee extra movement tempo. Concentration sacrifices remote barriers. Fresh validation required before promotion.
